description: A data drive under /var/mnt is above 90% (Time Machine's drive has its own alert)

spec.name: A
spec.query: sum by ("k8s.node.name", mountpoint) ({"system.filesystem.usage", "k8s.node.name"!="ocifree", state="used", mountpoint=~"/var/mnt/.+", mountpoint!="/var/mnt/tm"}) / (sum by ("k8s.node.name", mountpoint) ({"system.filesystem.usage", "k8s.node.name"!="ocifree", state="used", mountpoint=~"/var/mnt/.+", mountpoint!="/var/mnt/tm"}) + sum by ("k8s.node.name", mountpoint) ({"system.filesystem.usage", "k8s.node.name"!="ocifree", state="free", mountpoint=~"/var/mnt/.+", mountpoint!="/var/mnt/tm"})) * 100
